title: BatchCheck dedupes the delegation check by group/resource/verb
answers: Why does BatchCheck only log/count the missing-delegation error once even with many items?
How to add a new per-request guard to BatchCheck without spamming logs/metrics per hit?
body:
In authzLimitedClient.BatchCheck (pkg/storage/unified/resource/access.go), the serviceCanDelegate guard is run once per unique group+resource+verb combination across itemsToCheck (via a seen map keyed on those three fields), not once per item, since a page of BatchCheck hits typically repeats the same combination many times.
Any new guard or metric added to BatchCheck's per-item loop should follow the same dedup pattern to avoid inflating log volume and counters proportional to page size.
